events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 5: Forensics And Investigations+
events.outline: This module provides an insight into the types and motivations of fraud and the obligations of an insolvency practitioner when faced with circumstances involving fraud. Participants will be introduced to a series of investigation methodology and the importance of forensic services in uncovering valuable evidence for the insolvency practitioner.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Day of Conveyancing Highlights 2026 – Day 2
events.outline: The Conveyancing Practice Committee presents its 14th annual "Day of Conveyancing Highlights," held as two half-day webinars covering different topics. Speakers include Leonard Tay (Knight Frank) on residential/commercial market trends, S. Suressh (Harry Elias Partnership) on anti-money laundering, Orson Zhu (SLA) on the upcoming Digital Conveyancing Portal, and Carrie Wong (SLA) on adaptive reuse of State properties - addressing property law, market dynamics, technology, and compliance for practitioners.

events.title: Corporate Law Day 2026+
events.outline:
For 2026, the Corporate Law Day event will take place over 2 days, include opportunities for networking,
and will continue to cover topics of particular interest to corporate law practitioners. Organised by
the Corporate Practice Committee, the topics for this year’s event include specialised interests (such
as, tax issues associated with corporate transactions), as well as practical matters and subjects of ongoing discussion (such as, practical guidance on using AI for corporate matters).

events.title: Maritime Arbitrator Accreditation Programme 2026
events.outline: The SCMA’s MAAP comprises two parts: an in-person workshop, consisting of two modules, will be held on 23 September 2026. An online Written Assessment will be held on 24 September 2026. Module 1: Statutory and Rule Framework for Maritime Arbitration – 2.5 hours. Module 2: Drafting the Award and Practical Issues – 2.5 hours.

events.title: From Trusted Advisor to Strategic Ally: Mastering Stakeholder Management for In-house Counsel
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline:
This course is designed for those who seek to enhance their effectiveness by mastering the art of stakeholder management. It is particularly beneficial for those looking to improve communication, build stronger internal and external relationships, and strategically navigate complex organizational dynamics. 

Participants will leave this course with actionable strategies, practical tools, and enhanced confidence to effectively manage their stakeholders, strengthen their influence within the organization, and drive better legal and business outcomes.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 15: Navigating Sexual Offence Cases: Legal Developments and Cross-Examination Strategies
events.outline: The last decade has seen a rise in sexual crime cases in Singapore. Join us for an in-depth discussion on how legislative changes, sentencing frameworks, and institutional responses are shaping the prosecution and defence of sexual assault cases.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Reinventing the World Court
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS - Centre for International Law. This forward-looking webinar explores how the ICJ can remain relevant and effective in the 21st century. It will consider the skills, expertise and qualities required of future ICJ judges, as well as how the Court can adapt its institutions and methods to address increasingly complex disputes. The session will also examine the changes needed to ensure that the ICJ remains an authoritative, resilient and fit-for-purpose world court.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Sustainability Reporting in the AI Age: Useful Tool or False Confidence?
events.venue: Webinar / 60 Cecil Street ISCA House Singapore 049709
events.outline: This multidisciplinary panel discussion examines the growing role of AI in sustainability reporting and explores whether AI improves reporting quality or creates false confidence. Participants will gain insights into the opportunities, limitations and risks of AI-assisted reporting, including issues relating to data quality, governance, accountability, oversight and professional judgement. The session will also consider how organisations can responsibly adopt AI while maintaining confidence in sustainability disclosures.

events.title: Litigation Strategy before International Courts and Tribunals by Peter Tzeng
events.venue: Seminar Room 3-2 @ NUS Bukit Timah Campus, Block B, Level 3, 469 Bukit Timah Road, Singapore 259756
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. High Commissioner Dr. Ambule will share his thoughts on how India and Singapore are strengthening cooperation, expanding collaboration and leveraging their respective strengths and complimentarities, for the benefit of the two countries, within the framework of their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

events.title: Lexplorer Workshop Series 3: The Confident Middle - Redefining Success for Women in Law
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: The session will combine short conceptual inputs with facilitated discussion using practical case studies drawn from real-world legal contexts.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Advocacy Fundamentals in Examination-In-Chief and Cross-Examination
events.outline: This is Session 3 of 4 webinars held in the lead-up to the Law Society's Criminal Trial Advocacy Course (CTAC) on 25 September 2026. This session introduces essential advocacy skills for examination-in-chief and cross-examination in criminal cases, covering how to structure examinations, elicit admissible evidence, avoid common pitfalls, and maintain control of witness evidence.

events.title: SIArb Fellowship Assessment Course 2026 - Workshop 2 to 6+
events.outline: FAC will focus on teaching candidates the practical aspects of acting as an Arbitrator.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Urgent Applications Without Notice: A Practical Guide for Pragmatic Practitioners
events.outline:
Urgent, without-notice applications demand speed and precision in taking instructions. This session offers practical guidance for handling these matters with confidence.
Topics covered include what to do when an urgent matter lands on your desk, key aspects such as full and frank disclosure and undertakings as to damages and the mechanics of getting matters heard urgently, including skeletal submissions under the Rules of Court 2021, as well as freezing/proprietary injunctions and search orders.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 6: Financial Assessment+
events.outline: Financial assessment is a key and integral part of a restructuring and insolvency practice. It is an essential skill in determining the solvency or otherwise of an organisation that is undergoing restructuring or insolvency. This module will equip participants with the knowledge and skills that are required to perform such financial assessment.

events.title: Navigating ICC Arbitration Rules 2026: Key Changes and Practical Implications
events.venue: Maxwell Chambers; Level 2, 32 Maxwell Road, Singapore 069115
events.outline:
1. Introduction to the 2026 Rules

2. Insights into how the 2026 Rules aim to enhance transparency, streamline proceedings, and respond to the changing needs of global dispute resolution.

3. Key amendments and new features, which will enable participants to leave with a practical understanding of what has changed, why it matters, and how to use the new Rules to their advantage.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Establishing Fraud, Unconscionable Conduct and Beyond
events.outline: This programme will address two distinct yet interconnected topics: fraud and unconscionable conduct in the context of financial instruments, and the practical considerations involved in establishing fraud in legal cases.

events.title: [WEBINAR] The (UN)visible United Nations – Episode 1: The Visible UN: Behind the Scenes of Progressive Development and Codification of International Law at the United Nations
events.outline: The UNvisible United Nations is a new CIL webinar series exploring lesser-known UN institutions that shape international law. Its first episode examines the roles of the International Law Commission, the General Assembly’s Sixth Committee and the UN Office of Legal Affairs. The session considers how these bodies interact, balance expert-led processes with State participation, and whether their approaches create fragmentation, synergy or productive contestation.

events.title: The Green Plan 2030 Five Years On: From Policy Vision to Legal Reality
events.venue: Linklaters Singapore Pte. Ltd.,  2 Central Boulevard #28-01, West Tower,  IOI Central Boulevard Towers, Singapore 018916
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This panel explores how the Singapore Green Plan 2030 has influenced environmental law and regulation across climate change, carbon markets, energy, transport, and the built environment, and what reforms may still lie ahead.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Bills of Lading: Dead, Spent or Still Alive?
events.outline: This event is organised by Singapore Chamber of Maritime Arbitration. This session explores discharge LOIs and the risks when banks retain bills of lading as security after delivery, including shipowners’ exposure and defences to misdelivery claims.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Senior Counsel Forum 2026 - Module 6: The UK perspective – Ethical Issues in AI and Lawyer’s Role in Administration of Justice
events.outline: The Senior Counsel Forum, by the Law Society of Singapore, returns with six modules led by distinguished Senior Counsel. Topics include court submissions, duty to the court, disciplinary processes, conflicts of interest, common ethical scenarios, and English ethics practice. An invaluable opportunity for lawyers to learn best practices in legal ethics, delivered virtually via Zoom.

events.title: [WEBINAR] The Odyssey of Reform: Charting Singapore’s Evolving R&I Landscape
events.outline: Singapore’s restructuring and insolvency landscape continues to evolve, driven by global shifts and deliberate adoption of international best practices. This seminar examines the 2026 reforms, including the permanent Simplified Insolvency Programme 2.0 and recommendations to strengthen Singapore’s restructuring regime. It also explores managing conflicts of interest through practical scenarios and sustainable work practices for restructuring and insolvency practitioners.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CALS Webinar - Ethics in Lived Reality: Mentoring in the Daily Grind
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This panel explores how legal ethics can be meaningfully integrated into the everyday training and mentorship of lawyers. Focusing on the role of ethical environments and mentoring in fostering sustainable ethical practice, the discussion brings together speakers from diverse backgrounds to share perspectives on practical challenges and effective strategies for embedding ethics into the daily realities of legal practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Judicial Attitudes to the Criminal Advocate
events.outline: This session discusses the judicial perspectives of what makes a good criminal defence advocate. Judges recognise that practitioners are not merely representing their clients but also play a vital role in assisting the Court in the administration of justice.

events.title: JLP - Effective Business Negotiation
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This one-day programme equips participants with a structured negotiation approach, practical communication tools, and strategies to handle resistance and rejection in client-facing negotiations. The workshop uses client-relevant scenarios to ensure learning is immediately transferable to real-world negotiation challenges in reinsurance and related commercial discussions.

events.title: Distinguished Visitor Lecture: New Era, New Concepts: Innovation and Development in China’s Company Law (2023) and Its Judicial Interpretations
events.venue: Wee Chong Jin Moot Court, NUS Law
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This seminar examines China’s 2023 Company Law revision and its judicial interpretations. It explores the law’s new principles, including stronger corporate governance, shareholder and creditor protection, and corporate social responsibility. Key reforms include changes to registered capital, directors’ duties, minority shareholder rights, simplified structures for small firms, and creditor safeguards, alongside their practical impact on governance and business practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Ponzi Insolvencies Across Jurisdictions
events.outline: This webinar examines modern Ponzi insolvencies, and the various legal, commercial and strategic issues that can arise. It delves into clawback litigation, tracing and recovery strategies, cross-border enforcement issues, and also cryptocurrency-related recovery challenges that arise through such insolvencies today. A number of jurisdictions are covered, from Singapore, US, and the UK.

events.title: Public Lecture on Climate Change “Legal and Scientific (Un)certainties: 10 Years after the Paris Agreement”
events.venue: NUS Bukit Timah Campus, Block B, Seminar Room 4-4, Singapore 259756
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. The Paris Agreement is now fully operational, with Parties required to submit new nationally determined contributions (NDC 3.0) for 2035 that are more ambitious and informed by the first global stocktake. As implementation takes centre stage, geopolitical tensions, technological advances, and competing commercial interests challenge effective climate governance. This seminar examines how international law can provide legal stability and strengthen the rule of law in climate action.

events.title: Integrated IP, Valuation & Tax (IIVT): A Strategic Toolkit for Decision-Makers+
events.outline:
IP Identification & Strategic Positioning
-Start from business strategy
-Identify the IP/IA that enables the strategy
-Prioritise and position IP/IA for competitive advantage

IP Commercialisation, Licensing & Structuring
-Commercialisation pathways for IP/IA
-Allocation of rights, obligations, and control
-Implementation and control

IP Due Diligence in M&A & Restructuring
-Objectives and scope of IP due diligence
-Common IP issues and early warning signs
-Dependence on IP and ability to operate

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 7: Business Valuation+
events.outline: This module will approach the subject of business valuation by navigating through the International Valuation Standards (IVS), focusing on the process, the various approaches and methods, and the challenges commonly encountered in their application.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Energy Justice and Just Transition
events.outline: This webinar is organised by NUS - Centre for International Law. This lecture introduces energy justice and its relevance to energy poverty, inequality, and climate change. It examines the five tenets of energy justice and their practical application, including trade-offs between affordability, energy security, and justice. The lecture then explores just transition in the energy sector within international climate law and policy, and concludes by considering the challenges of balancing transition speed, fairness, and implementation.

events.title: Self-Leadership for Lawyers: Taking Charge of your Work Life - Module 3
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This session, participants will learn about the optimal and sub-optimal impacts of stimulation vs stress on the way we think, feel, and act, and how to better regulate ourselves towards the “just right” place for greater sustainability and effectiveness.

events.title: Artificial Intelligence Governance in Europe and Beyond: The EU AI Act and International Law
events.venue: Seminar Room 4-4 @ NUS Bukit Timah Campus, Block B, Level 4, 469 Bukit Timah Road, Singapore 259756
events.outline: This event is organise by NUS - Centre for International Law. Professor Kaddous will examine how the EU AI Act is reshaping AI regulation within and beyond the EU, including its scope, risk-based duties, enforcement and interaction with fundamental rights and data protection. The lecture will explore cross-border jurisdiction, state responsibility, economic law and global standards, as well as implications for Switzerland. It will conclude with the Geneva AI Summit 2027’s potential role in advancing global cooperation on responsible AI governance.

events.title: Integrating ESG into Corporate Governance and Compliance
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: The course aims to equip inhouse counsel and private practitioners with an understanding of the key concepts and issues relating to sustainability and ESG and how to incorporate such concepts into corporate policies and strategies, ensuring they are equipped to advise organisations on best practices and compliance with relevant regulations

events.title: Women at the Bar: Advocacy, Leadership, Sustainability and Longevity
events.outline: Women in Advocacy returns for its second edition after a strong 2025 debut. Under the theme Women at the Bar: Advocacy, Leadership, Sustainability and Longevity, senior advocates, including an international voice, will discuss building a lasting career in litigation—from developing courtroom confidence and a personal advocacy style to navigating setbacks, progressing into leadership, and leading with authority and authenticity.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Tort Claims in Employment Disputes: Recent Developments
events.outline: This seminar examines the evolving role of tort claims in employment disputes with reference to recent Singapore court decisions as well as case law from other common law jurisdictions where applicable.

events.title: JLP - Costs and Enforcement
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Get equipped with a thorough understanding of P&P and S&C costs, and enforcement of judgments and awards, blending legal theory with practical skills to prepare them for the challenges they may face in their work.

events.title: Sanctions for Legal Ethical Breaches – Determining the Appropriate Sanction for Lawyer Misconduct
events.venue: SUSS Room at the State Courts
events.outline: This seminar focuses on the topic of sanctions, i.e. the punishment which an errant lawyer may face owing to breaches of the legal ethical norms. The aim of the seminar is two-fold: First, to provide a general introduction to the topic of sanctions. Second, to explore in detail the court’s approach in determining the appropriate sanction for a legal ethical breach and to offer guidance in this regard based on the existing case law.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (8 October)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: Words that Win: Witness Interviewing and Statement-Drafting Skills for Arbitration Practitioners
events.outline: Witness evidence is often the most important and most vulnerable part of an arbitration case. A well-prepared witness anchors a tribunal's findings; a poorly interviewed one can unravel under cross-examination. This workshop teaches young arbitration lawyers rarely-taught skills: conducting witness interviews, distinguishing recollection from reconstruction, and drafting persuasive, ethical statements. Participants interview a "live" witness, draft under time pressure, and confront a late-disclosed document — then debrief with senior practitioners on judgment calls and ethics.

events.title: Certificate in Family Office & Governance
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This module introduces the family office landscape, core functions, and role within the private wealth ecosystem. It covers family governance structures, constitutions, councils, ownership and board dynamics, and alignment of values and roles. Participants also examine family dynamics, cultural influences, conflict management, and the legal professional’s role, supported by case studies and practical discussions.

events.title: The Law Society Criminal Trial Advocacy Course 2026+
events.outline:
Following a successful 1st edition in October 2025, the Law Society of Singapore's Advocacy Committee will be working with criminal barristers from the Australian Bar Association for the 2nd edition of the Criminal Trial Advocacy Course.

With a slate of pre-course webinars, experienced speakers from various sides of the criminal justice system and interactive workshops, this Course will broaden your perspectives, sharpen your advocacy skills and enhance your preparation for a criminal trial.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Mediating Mis-selling: The Applicable Law & Guidelines
events.outline: This programme seeks to set out the law and relevant guidelines relating to mis-selling claims and includes the sharing of case scenarios for participants to work on.

events.title: Certificate for Family Office Advisors - Foundation+
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. The foundation level program uses real-world case studies to explain family offices, their functions, and the legal and fiscal context in which they operate. It also covers tools for long-term wealth protection and focuses on understanding the human context of wealth owners, including individuals, entrepreneurs, and families.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 8: Financing+
events.outline: This module will discuss the conditions for seeking rescue financing and the various practical challenges associated with it. It will further explore alternative structures for financing without going through a court process. The course will also do an in-depth study of previous cases in Singapore that had sought rescue financing and draw out the learning points for each case.

events.title: Persuasive Writing: Perspectives from the Bench
events.outline: Advocacy should persuade, not merely inform. Join this intimate seminar on the art of persuasive legal writing, seen through the judiciary's eyes. Distinguished speakers, a retired High Court Judge and a Judge of the Singapore International Commercial Court (UK-based), draw on decades on the bench to share what makes legal writing truly persuasive. Whether drafting submissions, pleadings, or affidavits, gain a rare chance to hear directly from judges on what works, and what doesn't.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ALB International M&A Transactions Masterclass 2026+
events.outline: The ALB International M&A Transactions Masterclass 2026 is an intensive, practical programme for legal counsel, corporate leaders and deal professionals seeking the technical clarity and commercial confidence to manage cross-border transactions from the initial term sheet through to completion.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer - SMU Asian Arbitration Lecture 2026: Caught in the Crossfire: Arbitration’s struggle with sanctions
events.venue: Webinar / Ngee Ann Kongsi Auditorium, SMU School of Accountancy
events.outline: This lecture examines how sanctions affect arbitration, from parties’ ability to participate in the arbitration process, to the enforcement of arbitral awards. It also considers the wider implications for transnational system of commercial justice, including escalation of costs and uncertainty, and weakening of arbitration as a reliable means for resolving cross-border disputes.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Corporate Accountability, Human Rights and Climate Justice in Asia
events.outline: This event is organized by National University of Singapore, Centre for International Law (NUS CIL). This session examines the intersection of climate justice, environmental justice, nature protection, and just transition in Asia. It explores the integration of human rights principles into climate and biodiversity frameworks, recent legal and policy developments, and emerging corporate accountability regimes. The session also considers how trade and investment laws can better align with climate, biodiversity, and human rights objectives to support a sustainable and equitable transition.

events.title: [WEBINAR] E154: Anti-Money Laundering / Combating The Financing Of Terrorism (“AML / CFT”) Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA). The course is designed to enable RFAs to demonstrate knowledge and understanding of AML/CFT legislations, regulatory trends and developments in Singapore, knowledge and understanding of the AML/CFT environment in Singapore and international trends and typologies, knowledge and understanding of how to carry out risk assessment and conduct various types of customer due diligence, familiarity with ACRA Guidelines for RFAs and awareness of how ACRA’s Compliance review and inspections impact RFAs.

events.title: LawNet Training Workshop (14 October 2026)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This training workshop guides attendees through the new features and functionalities of LawNet.com. Through walkthroughs and hands-on exercises, participants will learn how to use the revamped platform efficiently

events.title: 11th Asian Maritime Law Conference
events.outline: This event is organised by Maritime Law Association of Singapore. The Asian Maritime Law Conference (AMLC) 2026 is a one-day professional development conference organised by the Maritime Law Association of Singapore (MLAS). The conference provides a platform for legal practitioners, maritime professionals, academics, regulators, and industry stakeholders to gain practical insights into key developments shaping the maritime sector.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Navigating the Evolving Tax Landscape: Corporate Structures and Transactions
events.outline: Navigating the Evolving Tax Landscape: Corporate Structures and Transactions is a full-day seminar designed for legal practitioners, corporate advisors, and tax professionals. The program provides a comprehensive analysis of Singapore's tax regulatory framework, focusing on practical legal and commercial implications across corporate deal cycles, asset management, international compliance, and emerging digital markets.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] International Mediator Accreditation Workshop+
events.venue: Webinar / 137 Amoy Street, Far East Square, #03-06, Singapore 049965
events.outline: This event is organised by Sage Mediation Institute for Leadership Education Pte Ltd. Participants will hone their mediation skills through an in-depth exploration of mediation strategies, agile process-design and the complexities of international mediation. Through rigorous mediation role-plays and the assessment, constructive feedback will be provided for participants to continuously improve their mediation strategy and approach. Participants who pass the assessment are qualified to receive the P.E.A.C.E. Certificate for International Mediators (PCIM) from SMILE.

events.title: Advancing Muslim Law Practice: Contemporary Issues and Emerging Perspectives
events.outline:
The programme explores emerging issues in Singapore's Muslim law practice, while providing practical insights into the legal and practical considerations arising in matters concerning children.

The programme examines the legal principles, practical considerations and challenges faced by practitioners in advising and representing clients in Muslim law. The session considers how practitioners can navigate the intersection between legal principles, judicial approaches and practical considerations.

events.title: Advocacy My Way: A Fireside Chat with N Sreenivasan SC
events.venue: The Law Society of Singapore (Members’ Lounge) ,28 Maxwell Road #01-03, Maxwell Chambers Suites Singapore 069120
events.outline: In the second instalment of the Advocacy Committee’s “The Path of An Advocate” series, N Sreenivasan SC shares reflections from a distinguished career at the forefront of complex disputes. This fireside chat explores advocacy, ethics, resilience, mentorship, and adapting to technological and professional change, offering valuable insights on building a legal career and legacy grounded in purpose and the profession’s core values.

events.title: The Annual Medico Legal Seminar 2026+
events.venue: One Farrer Hotel, 1 Farrer Park Station Road, Singapore 217562
events.outline: This event is organised by Singapore Medical Association. Enhance your skills in the ethical, legal and communicative aspects of high-stakes care in end-of-life situations. Designed for physicians, nurses and social workers, the programme addresses key clinical and legal considerations, palliative care interventions and navigating difficult conversations with patients and families.

events.title: Procedures and Principles in the Contested Administration of Estates and Trusts
events.outline: The workshop will cover the procedural framework for and principles relating to contentious administration of estates and trusts under the Family Justice (Probate and Other Matters) Rules and other related subsidiary legislation and practice directions.

events.title: Certificate in Wealth, Succession and Legacy
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This course provides an overview of the legal and practical considerations in wealth transition and succession planning. Participants examine how purpose and governance influence long-term family decisions, and review key estate-planning tools and structures. The module also explores philanthropic planning and the role of legal practitioners in supporting families through legacy, governance, and wealth-planning discussions.

events.title: Life of Crime: Reflections from the Bar The Craft of Criminal Defence Advocacy, Ethics, Sustainability, Strategy and Access to Justice
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: he programme is intended for criminal practitioners, young lawyers and law students, and offers participants an opportunity to reflect on the competencies, values, and ethical foundations necessary for effective and sustainable criminal practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Disclosure, Not Discovery: Navigating the 2021 ROC Landscape
events.outline: This session will help litigators, junior lawyers and in-house counsel translate the new framework into practical litigation judgment: what to ask for, when to ask for it, how to resist overbroad requests, and how to use document production strategically without losing sight of the Ideals under the Rules of Court 2021.

events.title: ISDA Annual Legal Forum (APAC)
events.venue: Marina Bay Financial Centre, 25th Floor, Tower 3, 12 Marina Boulevard, Singapore, 018982
events.outline: The event is listed by International Swaps and Derivatives Association, Inc. (ISDA). ISDA’s Annual Legal Forum is the premier event for derivatives lawyers and regulatory and compliance professionals. Bringing together senior lawyers, regulators and market practitioners, the event provides the latest intelligence and analysis on the most important legal and regulatory issues affecting markets today.

events.title: Singapore Insolvency Conference 2026+
events.venue: PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Garden Ballroom Level 1
events.outline: This event is organised by Insolvency Practitioners Association of Singapore (IPAS). The Singapore Insolvency Conference 2026 (SIC 2026) brings together the restructuring and insolvency community to examine the evolution and future direction of restructuring and insolvency law and practice in Singapore and beyond. Building on four decades of transformation since the Pan-Electric crisis, the conference will explore how Singapore has developed into a leading international restructuring hub and consider the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead.

events.title: STEP Asia Conference 2026: Advising Families in an Emerging New World Order+
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention, 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956
events.outline: This event is organised by STEP (Singapore Branch). This Conference unpacks the latest emerging trends and innovative strategies shaping family advisory in today’s evolving landscape. Hear directly from experts in Australia, China, India, Indonesia, South Korea & Vietnam on how family needs are evolving across Asia. Sessions address core succession planning challenges: from tax transparency & compliance requirements to strategic family structures & sensitive matters e.g. matrimonial disputes, family governance & alternative dispute resolution.

events.title: Global Sanctions and Export Controls: Practical Insights for Legal Professional and Businesses
events.venue: Clifford Chance, 12 Marina Boulevard, Tower 3, #25-00, Marina Bay Financial Centre, 018982
events.outline: This networking session brings together senior representatives from legal practice and industry to share practical perspectives on navigating this evolving landscape. Moderated by Kai-Niklas Schneider (Clifford Chance Asia), the discussion will feature Michael Lamson (Linklaters), Andrew Macintosh (FTI Consulting), and Wan-Yi Ho (Deutsche Bank) as they discuss key developments in sanctions and export controls, the practical challenges facing businesses, and considerations for managing these risks in an increasingly complex global environment.

events.title: Client Management: Dealing with Vulnerable Clients+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: This 2-day in-person course equips legal professionals with practical skills to effectively manage and communicate with vulnerable clients, including those with mental health conditions, intellectual disabilities, or challenging behaviours. It integrates legal ethics, trauma-informed practice, and real-world scenarios to enhance client engagement and professional conduct.

events.title: STEP Singapore Young Professionals Network (YPN) Forum
events.venue: Meeting Room, Level 3, West Tower Marina One, 9 Straits View, Singapore 018937
events.outline: This event is organised by STEP (Singapore Branch). The Young Professionals Network Forum is designed for early to mid career tax and private client lawyers and wealth management professionals.  It addresses contemporary industry issues, essential technical know-how and crucial professional skills development. It also offers a valuable networking platform to empower future leaders. Participants will receive a Certificate of Participation from STEP Singapore, recognising their commitment to professional growth.

events.title: The Law Society Civil Trial Advocacy Course 2026+
events.outline: The course is an intensive 2.5-day programme which will require participants to prepare and perform as advocates in court, handling case analysis, opening and closing speeches, as well as examination and cross-examination of witnesses. The highlight of the course will culminate in a mock trial where participants, working in pairs, will conduct examination and cross-examination of expert witnesses and deliver oral submissions. At the end of the mock trial, the presiding Judge will provide an extempore judgment along with comments and feedback on the participants’ performance.

events.title: Certificate in Multi-Jurisdictional Tax and Structures
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute (WMI). This module examines how family offices navigate cross-border tax and regulatory environments. It covers key regimes across major jurisdictions, with a focus on Singapore’s Section 13 incentives, licensing and structuring considerations. Participants explore CRS, FATCA, global minimum tax, and emerging trends, applying insights through practical case studies on family office operations.

events.title: Navigating AI, Workplace Fairness and Workplace Investigations: HR Risk Management for In-house Counsel
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: We will explore how counsel can bridge the gap between "knowing" the law and "doing" the work of an operational leader, ensuring that the legal function acts as a driver of sustained competitive advantage rather than a mere cost centre.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 9: Managing Insolvencies and Risk Management+
events.outline: This module deals with the practical aspects of managing risks in the context of insolvency laws which insolvency practitioners (IPs), such as accountants and lawyers, face when they are appointed.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (29 October)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: IT LAW SERIES: Leveraging Technology Tools in the Legal Sector
events.outline: This seminar series aims to provide participants with an overview of some of the latest IT law issues and developments. Every session focuses on a different topic and will be conducted by a variety of leading practitioners and academics in the relevant field, who will deliver presentations and participate in a Q&A discussion with opportunities for participants to pose questions.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Lexplorer Workshop Series 4: From Self-Insight to Career Strategy+
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Join this transformative two-part lunchtime career navigation workshop, designed for legal professionals from any legal industry career track (with up to 15 years PQE). Facilitated by certified life coach Susan de Silva (The Silva Coach) and SAL legal professionals, this experience empowers you to take charge of your journey and build a meaningful, sustainable legal career. Through a blend of guided reflection, peer sharing and practical tools (like the LX Career Planner and LIFTED Self-Assessment Tool).

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 11: Capstone - Integrating the Concepts+
events.outline: This module will integrate and provide a coherent overview of the various insolvency and restructuring concepts, knowledge and tools taught in Modules 1 to 10 of the SMU-IPAS Graduate Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring through a combination of lecture and case study.

events.title: LES Singapore Basic Licensing Course 2026+
events.outline: Understand aspects of the licensing of intellectual property (IP) – particularly for trade marks, copyright, patents, and registered designs – at the LES Singapore Basic Licensing Course 2026! Organised together with the Licensing Executives Society (Singapore), our programme will cover the various principles and procedures involved in licensing negotiations. Learn how to effectively apply them in practice, through a “hands-on” scenario.
